author: Nebbsy
body:
Hello! My names Peacheh_Kat, and I'm from pallet town! (Pokemon joke). 

So so today was the release of the Omega Update. I just wanted to say it's a good feeling, nice hub, new game modes, and badges, morphs and Credits.

today I want to ask a question to everyone:
How many credits do you all have so far? 
I have 3056, (been playing and smashing threw on cth.)

Im saving 17.5k credits for a badge. I know a lot of people want the Omega Badge! But I don't have a desire for it and this one looks cool. 
what are you saving for :^)

-Peacheh_Kat<3
